flags.why: The construction 'giữa sinh tử' needs 'và' between the two things being contrasted.
flags.fix: Ranh giới giữa sinh và tử thật mong manh. = The line between life and death is so thin.

flags.why: In this sexual slang use, 'nháy' means a round of sex and does not specifically involve a prostitute.
flags.fix: noun [slang, vulgar] | a round of sex; a quickie

flags.why: The entry omits the common meaning of making something wider or more spacious.
flags.fix: verb | to widen; to enlarge — Họ nới rộng căn bếp. = They enlarged the kitchen.

flags.why: The entry omits the everyday meaning of a label or sticker attached to a product.
flags.fix: noun | label; sticker (on a product) — Đừng bóc tem bảo hành. = Don't peel off the warranty sticker.
